Welcome to Beansrout. Today we'll be training you on how to add notes to a specific address so your whole team has the information they need every time that stop comes up on a route. Start by making sure you're clocked in and assigned to a route for the day. Then, tap the deliver tab at the bottom of your screen to open your map. Tap any stop on the map to pull up the stop card. Once the stop is selected, tap the i button in the toolbar at the bottom of the stop card to open the info panel. This will open up the info section where you can add notes to the address.

title: Add Address Notes to a Stop - iPhone
text:
Video: 'Add Address Notes to a Stop - iPhone' (at 00:36)
Spoken Transcript:
Scroll down to the notes section. Type in any details specific to this address, gate codes, where to leave packages, or anything else your team needs to know. Then click save. Once you have saved your note, click the back button. Now the note will be available on the stop card. The note will also be available on the map if the show info under pin settings are enabled. You've successfully added a note to an address. Any notes added this way will be visible to your entire team every time that address appears as a stop on a route. This tool helps ensure every driver has the information they need to make a successful delivery.

In this video, let's see how to complete safety training courses in the Beans Route mobile app. When safety training is enabled for your business, drivers receive one safety training course each month and can complete the course using the Beans Route mobile app. Courses are assigned on the first day of the month and must be completed before the last day of the month to maintain a passing status. Courses include a short video module followed by a series of questions about the module. Before starting the safety training course, ensure you have a strong internet connection. Weak connectivity might prevent your quiz scores from being transmitted to Safety Forward.

The app will then take you to the safety forward website and launch the course.
